qa_pair.question: Within arch-optimize itself, which two scripts form the complementary review pair: one detects AI-flavor patterns (DEAD-001..010) in generated code, and one scans R1-R6 architecture decay risks? What is the recommended invocation order for a pre-merge review?
qa_pair.answer: scripts/detect_code_ai.py detects AI-flavor patterns (DEAD-001..010 with Blocker/Critical/Warning severities) and scripts/risk_diagnose.py scans R1-R6 decay risks (Symptom->Source->Consequence->Remedy findings). Recommended order: run detect_code_ai.py first (fast, deterministic), fix Blocker/Critical hits, then run risk_diagnose.py for architecture-level risks, then arch_optimize_quality_metrics for MI/CC baseline. The pair complements each other: code-level authenticity (AI flavor) vs architecture-level decay.
